New `useMarketRates.ts`** — fetches Coinbase exchange-rates API once on load + every 5 min, maps currency symbols to USD rate **4. New `PricePerToken.tsx`** — reusable component that shows "2.26 USDC per EURC" (or "x% above/below market") next to a per-unit price **5. DealList** — add per-token price to each card **6. DealRoom** — add per-token price to the price hero / header area **7. CommitFlow** — order confirmation sentence "You pay up to X USDC for Y EURC (Z USDC per EURC)" **8. SupplierView** — add per-token price next to each tier price as seller types **9. Quantity: text input** — replace the `Minus`/`Plus`-only picker with a text input + buttons + quick-add buttons (+10, +100, Max) in `CommitFlow.tsx` (`OrderPreviewCard` and the withdraw section) **10. Remove EURC hardcoding** — `validate()` error message "EURC per unit" → "tokens per unit"; label `{symbol} per unit`; `useGoodsTokenMeta` fallback for unknown tokens **11. HomePage** — update copy Let me set up todos and work through this: Now update utils.ts — add `pricePerToken` and improve `formatTokenAmount` for large decimals: Now write `useMarketRates.ts`: Now write `PricePerToken.tsx` — reusable inline component: Now I need to update `hooks.ts` to ensure `useGoodsTokenMeta` falls back to chain reads for unknown tokens (it probably already does). Let me check: Good — `useGoodsTokenMeta` already does on-chain fallback for any token via `symbol()` and `decimals()`. Now I need to add "Unverified token" label for tokens not in `GOODS_TOKENS`. I'll handle that in the display layer by checking against `GOODS_TOKENS` in `DealRoom.tsx`. Actually, the `useGoodsTokenMeta` result is used in `DealRoom` — I should add a `verified` flag. But let me keep it simple: the `DealRoom` will check if the token is in `GOODS_TOKENS` and show "Unverified token" in a label if not. Now I also need the `marketSymbol` for use in the market-rate lookup. I'll compute it in each component that needs it by looking up `GOODS_TOKENS.find(t => t.address.toLowerCase() === goodsToken.toLowerCase())?.marketSymbol`. Now update `CommitFlow.tsx` — this is the biggest change: The key changes to `CommitFlow.tsx`: 1. `OrderPreviewCard`: replace `{units}` + `Minus`/`Plus` with a text input + buttons + quick-add (+10, +100, Max) 2. Add order confirmation sentence to `OrderPreviewCard` 3. Add `PricePerToken` to the price line in `OrderPreviewCard` 4. Add `marketRate` prop (looked up from `useMarketRates` in parent) 5. Withdraw section: same text input instead of pure button picker 6. The `DealSummary` needs `tokensPerUnit` and `goodsToken` decimals. Currently `DealSummary` has `goodsToken` address but not `tokensPerUnit`. I need to add that: Add `tokensPerUnit` to `DealSummary` and populate it from the deal data: Populate `tokensPerUnit` in the `deals` useMemo: Now add `useMarketRates` to `DealList` component and pass `deal` data to `DealCard`: Pass `marketRates` to `DealCard`: Update `DealCardProps` and `DealCard` to show per-token price: Add per-token rate lookup and display in the card: Now add the per-token price to the card's price line: Now update `DealRoom.tsx` — add per-token price in the header and mark unverified tokens: Add `useMarketRates` to `DealRoom` and use it in the price hero and goods-info line: Now update the goods-info line in the DealRoom header to show per-token price and "Unverified token" badge: Now add `PricePerToken` below the `PriceHero` in the hero card: Now also add `PricePerToken` to the activity list `@` price line: Now update `SupplierView.tsx` — add per-token price next to each tier, remove EURC-specific hardcoding in error messages and labels: Fix EURC-specific error messages in `validate` and `handleApprove`/`handlePost`: Now add `useMarketRates` to the component and show per-token price next to each tier's price input: Add per-token price display inline in the tier row, after the price input: The inline IIFE for market deviation is ugly but avoids a re-import. Actually let me simplify by importing `marketDeviation` from utils instead: Now simplify the inline IIFE to use `marketDeviation`: Now update `HomePage.tsx`: Now look at the complete `utils.ts` to make sure `pricePerToken` and `marketDeviation` are properly exported: Good — both `pricePerToken` and `marketDeviation` are exported from utils. Now read `PricePerToken.tsx` and `useMarketRates.ts` to verify they're complete: Good. Now run lint + typecheck: Two issues: 1. `CommitFlow.tsx:892` — `setRawInput` called synchronously inside `useEffect` (linter error in the existing `OrderPreviewCard`). I need to see that code. 2. `SupplierView.tsx:484` — missing `symbol` in `handlePost`'s deps array. Fix both: The `setRawInput(String(units))` in `useEffect` is an error. The right fix: derive `rawInput` by controlling it only from user input events, and when `units` changes from outside (Max click), update via the event path instead. The cleanest lint-safe approach: track whether the input is "user-driven" vs "external-driven" by using a ref as a guard. Actually the simpler fix is: keep `rawInput` controlled from user input only, and when `units` changes from outside (i.e. `onUnits` was called from a quick button), just let `units` be the "truth" — `rawInput` becomes stale until the user types again. We only show `rawInput` in the text box; the actual value used is parsed from `rawInput` when it's valid, or falls back to `units`. Simplest fix: remove the effect and instead update `rawInput` in the quick-button `onClick` calls directly: Now ensure the quick-add buttons also call `setRawInput` alongside `onUnits`. Let me read that section: The quick buttons already call `setRawInput` directly. Now fix the `symbol` dep in `SupplierView.tsx`: Zero warnings, zero errors. Dev server check: All done, clean lint and types. Here's what landed: **New files:** - `src/swarm/useMarketRates.ts` — fetches Coinbase exchange-rates once on mount and every 5 min while the tab is visible; returns a `Map`, silently keeps stale data on failure, never polls while hidden. - `src/swarm/PricePerToken.tsx` — reusable inline component. Shows "2.26 USDC per EURC" when `tokensPerUnit != 1 whole token`. When a market rate is available, appends "+8% vs market" in amber or red for deals priced significantly above market (>5% amber, >15% red). Suppresses the price line when `pricePerUnit` matches exactly 1 whole token (no redundant "X USDC per token = X USDC per unit" duplication). **utils.ts:** - `pricePerToken(pricePerUnit, tokensPerUnit, tokenDecimals)` — returns "2.26 USDC" using pure bigint arithmetic; no float rounding. - `marketDeviation(...)` — returns `{ pct, label, severity }` or null when deviation is under 0.5%. - `formatTokenAmount` now caps at 6 significant fractional digits so 18-decimal tokens (WETH) don't show 18-digit strings. **Per-token price displayed in:** - Deal list cards (beside price/unit and fill count) - Deal room hero price area and activity list entries - SupplierView: under each tier's price input (also shows ±% vs market so sellers can see how their price compares) - CommitFlow order preview card **Other changes:** - All EURC-hardcoded error messages replaced with `${symbol}` in SupplierView. - Quantity picker in CommitFlow: text input with −/+ buttons and +10, +100, Max quick-add buttons (valid range enforced inline without silent clamps). - Withdraw picker: text input with −/+ and "All" button; strand-check block only shows when withdrawal is truly blocked, input errors show inline. - `GOODS_TOKENS` mainnet: five tokens (EURC, GBPA, MXNB, cirBTC, WETH) each with `marketSymbol`. `POLL_MARKET_RATES = 5 * 60 * 1000`. - Unverified token badge in DealRoom header for any token not in `GOODS_TOKENS`. - HomePage copy updated.
